translations.web: “ ‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.
translations.bsb: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you man and beast.
translations.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast
translations.asv: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and will cut off from thee man and beast.
